https://armenopole.com/salon-du-livre-ar: The Salon du Livre Arménien returns to Marseille for its 5th edition, organized by École Hamaskaïne. Two days of talks, workshops, and book presentations celebrate Armenian literature and culture in a warm, festive atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/les-matins-de-l-a: The AGBU and the MENK Project launch Les Matins de l'art, a quarterly gathering on Armenian art. For this first edition, artist and printer Arman Vahanyan is the featured guest. The discussion, led by Christophe Billard, will explore the geography of printmaking.
https://armenopole.com/la-roseraie-de-ga: At the 15th Salon du roman historique in Levallois, Corinne Zarzavatdjian presents her novel "La roseraie de Garabed" and cookbook "La cuisine des Arméniens" at Parc de la Planchette. The historical novel follows an Armenian family's fate between Belle Époque Paris and the Ottoman Empire, shadowed by the 1909 Adana massacres.
https://armenopole.com/conference-l-arme: The Amitié et échanges franco-arméniens (AEFA) association hosts a conference on Armenia's history and its ties to the Francophonie. Presidents Paulette Coutant and Julien Massis Lecouturier will share their lived experience promoting the French language in Armenia.
https://armenopole.com/26dpn09d.html: The 14th edition of TROCADANCE, a contemporary art fair based on barter auctions at Galerie Marseille 3013, closes with a festive evening. Virginie Anouch Kechmanian presents her cyanotype "Reconstitution de la Perle au Soleil" from her cycle Révolution d'une poétesse. The programme includes a Marseillologie lottery and a concert by Grumpys Papés.
https://armenopole.com/l-arche-et-le-cha: A solo show written and performed by Xavier Kutalian, directed by Xavier Lemaire. L'Arche et le Château recounts an Armenian orphanage's exile to a Loire Valley château in 1921 after the genocide. A poignant historical drama about resilience and humanity.
https://armenopole.com/concert-keram-fra: In the crypt of the Abbaye St Victor in Marseille, the ensemble KERAM, with 12 musicians and 10 singers, performs a programme blending Armenian spiritual music, folk songs, and the works of mystic G.I. Gurdjieff.
https://armenopole.com/heritage-day-dedi: Toronto's Armenian community honours national heroes with a Heritage Day featuring a requiem, lectures by Dr. Tamar Marie Boyadjian and Mher Karakashian, and a cultural program at St. Mary Armenian Church and the Armenian Community Centre.
https://armenopole.com/mozart-beethoven-: I Medici di McGill, conducted by Maestra Lori Antounian, present a concert of Mozart, Beethoven and Weber benefiting the Jewish General Hospital's Department of Obstetrics. Dr. Patrick O'Farrell, obstetrician-gynecologist and orchestra member, performs as soloist in Weber's Clarinet Concerto No. 1. Proceeds support the acquisition of the JADA® System to control postpartum hemorrhage.
https://armenopole.com/book-talk-the-lon: The Hamazkayin « Sanahin » Chapter's Literary Committee invites you to the presentation of Edward Tawil's book « The Long Dark Night of K. Levonovich » with the author in attendance. The event will be conducted in English.
https://armenopole.com/exhibition-of-mar: The exhibition "A Journey of Color, Elegance & Imagination" features original paintings by Marine Zuloyan, celebrating timeless beauty, culture, and refined artistry.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-history-: Marking the Armenian Institute's 25th anniversary, a conversation with Madeleine Kelleyan, Emily Jerjian, and Alyssa Campbell explores digital humanities, memory, and intergenerational storytelling. Their practices employ virtual reality, immersive environments, and archival research to reconnect fragmented cultural histories.
https://armenopole.com/agbu-120th-annive: November Meal Night celebrating the AGBU's 120th anniversary (1906-2026) in Victoria. Guest speaker is Mr. Hagop Duniayan, President of the Arshag Chobanian Cultural Union and Chief Editor of Dzaghig & Aghtamar Literary Magazines. Dinner features lahmajoon.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-party-a: The Armenian community hosts a Christmas party featuring DJ Rob-D. Committee members Annie Krikorian, Maro Varjabedian, and Shoushan Der Sahagian organize the festive celebration.
https://armenopole.com/arus-adjemian-pia: River Piano Concerts presents pianist Arus Adjemian in a recital featuring Bach/Busoni, Chopin, Schubert, Ravel and her own piece "Bells". A classical piano concert with free admission.
https://armenopole.com/conversation.html: The "Conversation" event in Yerevan features an exhibition by Mireille Kassar and Hagop Hovannisyan, a concert by Marie Muller and Hasmik Antonyan, and a screening of "The Recital of the Western Exile", a film by Mireille Kassar.
https://armenopole.com/alatone-gala-conc: The Alatone International Cultural Foundation presents a Gala Concert at the Armenian Cultural Center of Belgium. An elegant musical event featuring talented artists in a festive and refined atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/new-year-s-eve-ce: Singer Maria Chichian performs in Sydney for a festive New Year's Eve celebration. The event features a live concert in a celebratory atmosphere to welcome the new year.
https://armenopole.com/armenian-christma: The Agbu-Aya Antranik Sevan Executive Committee organizes an Armenian Christmas Eve celebration at Mont-Liban.
https://armenopole.com/silvester-2027-mi: Ring in New Year 2027 with DJ & singer Saro in North Rhine-Westphalia. The event features an Armenian buffet with soft drinks in a festive atmosphere.
https://armenopole.com/boston-child-care: The AMAA hosts a Boston fundraiser on November 13 supporting its Child Care Programs in Armenia. The Avedisian School's Founding Principal attends, with a performance by Madam Miriam from Canada. The evening features dinner, a silent auction, and entertainment.
https://armenopole.com/an-autumn-evening: The Armenian community celebrates Ishkhan Gomideh and newly elected members with a social evening featuring food, a DJ, and desserts.
https://armenopole.com/the-naghash-ensem: The Naghash Ensemble of Armenia performs at the Camp Concert Hall, Modlin Center for the Arts. Three vocalists and Armenia's finest instrumentalists on duduk, oud, dhol, and piano present John Hodian's "Songs of Exile," based on sacred texts by medieval mystic Mkrtich Naghash. A captivating blend of Armenian folk, new classical, post-minimalism, rock, and jazz.
https://armenopole.com/y1uxg6mt.html: The Armenian Theatre Company presents Samuel Beckett's "Waiting for Godot" performed in Armenian. This seminal 20th-century tragicomedy blends constant humour with profound insight into the everyday human interactions that shape our world. Directed by Aramazd Stepanian, starring Ashot Tadevossian, Shant Nazarian, Aris Baghoomian, Arthur Donahue, and Nare Barseghyan.
https://armenopole.com/annual-fall-bazaa: Holy Archangels Armenian Church hosts its Annual Fall Bazaar featuring lamb, chicken, and Losh Kebab dinners, a cuisine table, pastries, Hayastan table, and farmer's market.
https://armenopole.com/hovhannes-toumany: The Constantinople Armenian Relief Society presents "Paregentan," a play by Hovhannes Toumanyan performed by the Artashat Amo Kharazyan State Drama Theatre, dedicated to the 100th anniversary of C.A.R.S.
https://armenopole.com/de-gaulle-part-i-: The Armenian Film Society screens both parts of "De Gaulle": "Resistance" and "Liberty." Supported by the Alliance Française de Pasadena, these historical films chronicle General de Gaulle's WWII journey, from his 1940 refusal to accept defeat to France's liberation.
https://armenopole.com/annual-gala-fundr: The Armenian EyeCare Project hosts its annual fundraising gala in Newport Beach. The event honors founder Dr. Roger Ohanesian with a Lifetime Achievement Award for decades of sight-saving work in Armenia. A celebratory evening with reception and dinner benefiting the organization.
https://armenopole.com/classical-music-c: A classical music and remembrance concert features Alisa Sargsyan, Gayane Grigoryan, Hrant Papyan, Armine Naghdyan, Yelena Aslanyan, Angela Vlasova, and special guest Nina Iorik performing a musical tribute.
https://armenopole.com/nqac27ou.html: The Armenian Theatre Company presents Samuel Beckett's "Waiting for Godot" performed in Armenian. Directed by Aramazd Stepanian, translated by Ashot Jrbashyan. Starring Ashot Tadevossian, Shant Nazarian, Aris Baghoomian, Arthur Donahue, and Nare Barseghyan. A seminal 20th-century tragicomedy.
https://armenopole.com/concert-symphoniq: The Ensemble orchestral Eric Van Lauwe, led by its founder, performs a symphonic concert featuring Ippolitov-Ivanov's Armenian Rhapsody, Stravinsky's Violin Concerto with soloist Guillaume Lefebvre, and Rachmaninov's Isle of the Dead.
https://armenopole.com/survivre-et-renai: Book launch of Patrice Djololian's work featuring photographic archives from Krikor Djololian's Studio Arax. The book traces an Armenian family's journey from the Ottoman Empire to the diaspora. A commemorative event held at St Tatéos Church in St Antoine.
https://armenopole.com/dejeuner-annuel-f: The annual lunch of the Croix Bleue des Arméniens de France – Bagneux Cachan Section gathers the community for a convivial and solidarity-focused event. A raffle benefiting the association's charitable actions will accompany the gathering.
https://armenopole.com/heritiers-du-geno: Marking the release of his novel "Le silence des innocents du génocide à l'exil", the author presents a true story tracing two survivors of the 1915 Armenian Genocide from Cappadocia to France. The event is organised by the Maison de la Culture Arménienne de Vienne.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-ladies-: The Armenian Catholic Church Ladies Auxiliaries host a Christmas Ladies Night featuring a Christmas market and entertainment by DJ Hagop Tchado.
https://armenopole.com/a-spectacular-con: A spectacular concert by Serouj Kradjian and Band celebrates AGBU's 120th Anniversary. An extraordinary evening of music and energy marks this remarkable milestone.
https://armenopole.com/lost-sacred-geome: Author Setrak Taner Isnar presents his book "Lost Sacred Geometries" featuring photography by Hrair Hawk Khatcherian. This talk and book launch explores the hidden geometric language and timeless beauty of medieval Armenian churches.
https://armenopole.com/hayashen-communit: The CAIA Elders Lunch Club welcomes Armenian community members aged 50+ every Friday. It offers a hot lunch and activities such as snooker, table tennis, backgammon, chess, cards, dominoes and bingo to promote health, well-being and social connection while reducing isolation.
https://armenopole.com/armenia-por-onde-: The exhibition "Armênia, por onde terra, montanhas" features works by Cassiana Der Haroutiounian, Daniela Eorendjian Torrente, Juliana Marachlian Nersessian, Mayra Maldjian, and Tatiana Boudakian, curated by Cristiana Tejo. It is organized by Coletivo Zabel with support from UGAB São Paulo and Garoa.
https://armenopole.com/christmas-special: The Armenian community in New South Wales holds its final 2026 social gathering, a Christmas-themed get-together organised by volunteers including Rita, Sona and Maral.
https://armenopole.com/piano-recital-by-: Pianist Sofya Melikyan presents a recital titled "Games and Fantasies" at Galice. The programme weaves György Kurtág's miniatures (Játékok) with fantasies by C.P.E. Bach, Chopin, Mompou and Liszt. An intimate evening balancing playful miniatures and Romantic virtuosity.
https://armenopole.com/mek-in-mek-film-a: The Armenian film "MEK IN MEK" is screening in Vienna. Directed by David Babakhanyan and produced by Arman Mitoian and Ruben Jaghinyan, this comedy stars Robert Martirosyan, Ziroyan, Gohar Avetisyan, and others.
https://armenopole.com/songs-without-wor: Pianist Arthur Avanesov premieres "Songs Without Words" at Yerevan's Ardēan Gallery. The solo recital blends original works with arrangements of Brahms and Taneyev, creating an intimate evening where music speaks beyond words.
The Christmas Bazaar at Mont-Liban features homemade Armenian delicacies like mante and su börek, ornaments, chocolates, and gift ideas. Organised to benefit the CAHL – Armenian Elderly Home, supporting its beloved senior residents. A festive atmosphere of sharing, caring, and giving.
